name: Pie
summary: Round fruit pie with a golden lattice crust in a white dish, optionally with a slice cut out, for dessert scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the dish rests on y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the item is hero size (~500 px wide); use about 0.2–0.3 next to a person

params.name: slice
params.note: cut one wedge out and move it aside

params.name: filling
params.note: filling colour seen in the gap, e.g. cherry red, apple #E0A21F

params.name: anim
params.note: bob = gentle up and down, wobble = small rock, pop = scale in with overshoot

author: krakujs
